默认跟随已下发模型。未全局下发的模型也可在这里单独授权给该用户，仍须开放对应供应: Users follow globally enabled models by default. You can also grant this user a model that is not globally enabled; its provider must be allowed.
全部下发模型（含以后新增）: All enabled models, including future additions
保存后从下一轮调用生效。已选但不再开放的模型会回退到可用模型；没有可用模型时暂停: Changes apply to the next run. Selections that are no longer allowed fall back to an available model. Calls are blocked when no model is available.
选择的供应商或模型不存在，请刷新后重试: A selected provider or model no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
模型未对该用户开放，请联系管理员: This model is not available to the user. Contact an administrator.
当前没有对你开放的模型，请联系管理员设置模型权限: No model is available to you. Contact an administrator to grant model access.
接入方式、智能体与服务账号: Access mode, agents and service accounts
供应商、模型能力与并发控制: Providers, model capabilities and concurrency limits
服务器资源、模型队列与调用任务: Server resources, model queues and service tasks
免鉴权模式允许不带凭据调用智能体的 MCP、A2A 和任务 API。免鉴权调用共: Anonymous mode allows MCP, A2A and task API calls without credentials. Anonymous callers share task and file access and queue limits. IP addresses are recorded for logs only and may be unavailable. Web sign-in still requires an account.
调用者需使用服务账号凭据。它与模型供应商 API Key 相互独立，服务对象不会: Callers need service account credentials. These are separate from provider API keys; callers never receive your model credentials.
服务账号名称不能超过 80 个字符: Service account names cannot exceed 80 characters
有效天数请输入 1–3650 之间的整数: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 3650
已创建，请在弹窗中复制凭据。: Created. Copy the credential from the dialog.
更换“{p0}”的凭据？旧凭据会立即失效。: Rotate the credential for “{p0}”? The previous credential will stop working immediately.
永久删除“{p0}”？相关调用历史、任务和文件会一并清理，凭据立即失效。: Permanently delete “{p0}”? Its call history, tasks and files will be removed, and its credential will stop working immediately.
访问路径请使用小写字母、数字和连字符，最多 63 位: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens for the URL slug, up to 63 characters
提供方名称和网址请同时填写，或同时留空: Enter both the provider name and URL, or leave both blank
已保存。新请求立即使用此配置。: Saved. New requests use this configuration immediately.
删除“{p0}”的配置？存在保留任务时，需先停用并等待任务清理。: Delete the configuration for “{p0}”? If retained tasks exist, disable the agent and wait for cleanup first.
同一基座可提供多个智能体。每个智能体独立配置介绍、默认模型和 Skill，调用入: One runtime can serve multiple agents. Each agent has its own description, default models and skills, with endpoints at /agent/<name>/a2a and /agent/<name>/mcp.
配置介绍与技能后，即可提供 MCP 和 A2A 调用入口。: Configure a description and skills to publish MCP and A2A endpoints.
服务账号用于程序接入。创建或更换凭据后只显示一次，请交给调用方保存。凭据与模型: Service accounts are for programmatic access. Credentials are shown once on creation or rotation; the caller must save them. They are separate from model API keys. Deleting an account clears its call history. Anonymous mode skips this step.
有效期为 1–3650 天。凭据到期后需由管理员更换。: Credentials last 1–3650 days. An administrator must rotate them after expiry.
凭据仅在此显示一次。关闭后无法再次查看；如果遗失，请更换凭据。: This credential is shown only once. You cannot view it after closing this dialog; rotate it if lost.
通用示例：名称为“我的智能体”，访问路径为 my-agent，对应 /agent: Example: name “My agent”, URL slug my-agent, served at /agent/my-agent/. The description is public; instructions are used only on the server.
使用小写字母、数字和连字符，最多 63 位。创建后固定，用于 /agent/<n: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, up to 63 characters. The slug is fixed after creation and used for endpoints under /agent/<name>/.
说明智能体提供的能力和适用场景: Describe the agent's capabilities and use cases
图像推理工具使用的模型。自动选择时跟随平台视觉模型；只列出标记为具备视觉能力的模: Used by image reasoning tools. Automatic selection uses the platform vision model. Only models marked as vision-capable are listed.
原视觉模型不可用，请重新选择: Previous vision model unavailable; choose another
仅在服务端执行，不会公开到 Agent Card。为这个智能体补充角色和工作规则: Used only on the server and never published in the Agent Card. Define this agent's role and working rules.
定义角色、工作方式和输出要求（可选）: Define a role, workflow and output requirements (optional)
选择平台技能。已启用技能才会下发；停用技能仍可保留选择，重新启用后恢复下发。公开: Select platform skills. Enabled skills are distributed; disabled selections are retained and resume distribution when enabled. The public Card and actual distribution use the same selections.
保存后显示完整调用入口。: Save to view the full endpoints.
供应商已创建，可继续添加模型: Provider created. You can now add models.
并发上限请输入非负整数: Enter a non-negative whole number for the concurrency limit
请输入非负整数，0 表示不限制: Enter a non-negative whole number; 0 means unlimited
并发上限已设为 {p0}，超出调用自动排队: Concurrency limit set to {p0}; additional calls will queue
切换会重新加载在线会话中的模型配置。正在执行的请求也可能受影响，确认应用？: This reloads model configuration in online sessions and may affect running requests. Apply the change?
请输入非负整数，或留空使用默认值: Enter a non-negative whole number, or leave blank for the default
模型服务的密钥只保存在服务端。留空保存时保留已有密钥；不会出现在 Agent C: Model credentials are stored only on the server. Leave blank when saving to keep the existing key. Keys are never published in Agent Cards.
并发按模型计数。0 表示不限制；超出上限的网页、MCP 和 A2A 请求在服务端: Concurrency is counted per model. 0 means unlimited. Web, MCP and A2A calls above the limit wait on the server for a free slot.
还没有模型，在下方添加。: No models yet. Add one below.
新建供应商，配置 API 地址和模型，即可开始使用。: Create a provider, configure its API URL and models, and start using the service.
每条消息的连续工具调用上限。留空使用默认值 {p0}；0 为无限制。保存会重新加: Maximum consecutive tool calls per message. Leave blank for the default ({p0}); 0 means unlimited. Saving reloads online session configuration.
监控本机 CPU、内存、磁盘与 UMEKO 进程。模型运行在远端时，这里不显示远: Monitor local CPU, memory, disk and the UMEKO process. Remote model GPU usage is not shown. Refresh pauses when you leave this page or hide the window.
模型并发上限可在模型与供应商页面设置。达到上限后等待，名额释放后继续执行。: Set per-model concurrency limits in Models & Providers. Calls wait at the limit and resume when a slot is available.
排队上限 {p0}，执行工作线程 {p1}。每个调用者最多 {p2} 个未结束任: Queue capacity: {p0}; workers: {p1}. Each caller can have up to {p2} unfinished tasks. Completed tasks are retained for {p3} hours.
卸载后会保留历史记录，正在进行的运行会停止。: History is retained after unloading, but the current run will stop.
永久删除该会话及附件、生成文件和聊天记录？: Permanently delete this session, attachments, generated files and conversation history?
卸载内存会话会停止当前运行，但保留历史；删除会永久清理历史和文件。: Unloading stops the current run and retains history. Deleting permanently removes history and files.
放弃当前文件的修改？: Discard changes to the current file?
技能名称请使用字母、数字、下划线和连字符: Use letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens for skill names
脚本名请使用 xxx.py，不带路径: Use a script name such as xxx.py, without a path
成员文件须为 .md/.json/.yaml/.txt/.csv，不带路径: Supporting files must use .md/.json/.yaml/.txt/.csv, without a path
文件已存在，请选择它进行编辑: File already exists. Select it to edit.
请先保存脚本，再运行测试: Save the script before running a test
超时请输入 1–30 之间的整数: Enter a whole number from 1 to 30 for the timeout
主文件定义技能，同名目录保存脚本和成员文件。保存主文件会同步下发副本；开关控制是: The main file defines a skill; its matching directory holds scripts and supporting files. Saving the main file updates distributed copies. The toggle controls distribution. Drag files in or use Import to upload.
永久删除“{p0}”及其全部会话、附件和历史记录？: Permanently delete “{p0}” and all their sessions, attachments and history?
仍有执行任务，请在资源监控中停止: Tasks are still running. Stop them in Resources first.
未配置 UMEKO_PUBLIC_URL，是否已上线？: UMEKO_PUBLIC_URL is not configured. Has this service been deployed?
执行会话尚未建立或已清理，输入与任务事件仍可查看。: The execution session has not started or has been removed. Input and task events are still available.
仅查看已保存的输入、会话、工具记录和配置快照，不会重新执行任务或加载模型。上下文: Inspect saved input, conversations, tool calls and configuration without rerunning tasks or loading models. This is not a complete capture of every model request. Up to 500 recent run events are retained; large events may be abbreviated.
会话历史可能包含已经清空或压缩的旧消息。此处列出保留的消息、摘要、技能挂载；机器: History may contain messages removed by clearing or compaction. This view shows retained messages, the summary and mounted skills; machine tasks also include the submitted agent configuration. Base prompts, temporary messages and individual model requests are not fully persisted.
保存后显示 Agent Card。: Save the agent to view its Agent Card.
这里预览已保存配置生成的公开 A2A Agent Card。未保存的修改不会出现: Preview the public A2A Agent Card generated from saved configuration. Unsaved changes do not appear in the card or MCP disclosure.
先保存智能体，再查看 MCP 披露详情。: Save the agent before viewing its MCP disclosure.
这里展示外部 MCP 客户端通过 tools/list 看到的工具，不是 Age: These are the tools external MCP clients discover through tools/list, rather than internal Agent tools or Skills. Agents share the service interface and run tasks with their own models and skills. tools/list is a JSON-RPC method sent to the MCP endpoint, not a /mcp/tools/list web path. This view reads SDK registrations without executing tools or calling models.
这是请求结构示例，arguments 需要按照参数表补充；不会在这里执行调用。需: This is a request format example. Fill arguments according to the parameter table. No calls are executed here. Include Authorization when credentials are required.
umeko:// 是 MCP 逻辑资源 URI，不是 HTTP 下载地址，不添加: umeko:// is a logical MCP resource URI, not an HTTP download URL; it has no deployment prefix. Artifact download URLs come from get_task results.
当前没有对外披露 MCP 提示词: No MCP prompts are currently disclosed
所选披露模型不存在，请从当前模型列表中选择: A disclosed model no longer exists. Select from the current model list.
该智能体未披露此主模型，请使用默认模型或已披露模型: This main model is not disclosed by the agent. Use its default or a disclosed model.
默认主模型始终可用。勾选允许调用方发现和选择的其他主模型；MCP list_mo: The default main model is always available. Select other main models callers may discover and use. MCP list_models, REST and A2A share this scope. All models includes future additions; default only prevents switching to other models.
仅展示 workspace、attachments、generate 的名称、相: Shows names, relative paths, sizes and modification times in workspace, attachments and generate without reading, previewing or downloading file contents. New tasks save a metadata snapshot at task end, retained with the task even if files are removed. Older tasks show the current directory, or only recorded uploads and artifacts if files were cleared; paths then serve as grouping labels. Links are not followed. Large or deep trees are marked incomplete.
工作文档专用工具已移除。旧授权不会自动扩大为通用文件权限，请按需选择 read_: Working-note tools have been removed. Old grants do not expand to general file access. Select read_document or write_file if needed; saving removes the retired grants.
内置工具的全局下发与用户权限: Global dispatch and user access for built-in tools
按工具名称、标识或分类搜索…: Search by tool name, identifier or category…
需要相应模型的视觉能力: Requires the appropriate vision model capability
控制平台主 Agent 和子 Agent 的工具下发。用户默认跟随全局设置，也可: Control tools for the main Agent and subagent. Users inherit global dispatch or receive individual grants in Users. Model capabilities and server configuration must still meet the tool requirements.
保存后下一轮调用重新加载；已撤销的工具会在执行时拒绝。机器任务答案提交是协议必需: Changes reload on the next turn. Revoked tools are rejected at execution. Result submission is required by the machine task protocol and is only exposed in machine tasks.
默认跟随全局下发。可单独授权未全局下发的工具；取消全部可配置工具不会禁用机器任务: Inherit global dispatch by default. You can grant tools that are not globally dispatched. Removing all optional tools keeps machine task result submission available.
